majors.name: Chemistry
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Chemistry. Requires 12 Level I core credits, 12 Level I elective credits, 30 advanced core chemistry credits, and 30 advanced elective credits.

majors.name: Physics
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Physics. Requires 12 Level I core credits (PHYS 1221-1224), 12 Level I elective credits, 30 advanced core credits (10 courses including labs and research project), and 30 advanced elective credits. Students should not read ESST 1000 or ESST 2004.

majors.name: Electronics
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Electronics from the Department of Physics. Requires 12 Level I core credits (COMP 1601, MATH 1141, MATH 1142, PHYS 1223), 12 Level I electives, 27 advanced core credits, 3 departmental elective credits, and 30 advanced elective credits. Students must register for year-long PHYS 3202 (not PHYS 3163).

majors.name: Biochemistry
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Biochemistry from the Department of Life Sciences. Requires 21 Level I core credits, 3 Level I elective credits, 24 advanced core credits (including 1.5-credit practicals), 6 advanced elective credits, and 30 other advanced credits. MATH 1115 required unless exempt via CAPE Pure Mathematics.

majors.name: Biology
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Biology from the Department of Life Sciences. Requires 15 Level I core credits (including MATH 1115), 9 Level I elective credits, 30 advanced core credits (10 BIOL courses), and 30 advanced elective credits. CHEM 1062 required for students without CAPE Chemistry. Joint Biochemistry/Biology majors must not read BIOL 2164 and BIOL 2360. Students with Math/Stats major/minor should not read BIOL 2163.

majors.name: Environmental Science
majors.description: BSc degree with a Major in Environmental Science from the Department of Life Sciences. Requires 15 Level I core credits (ESST 1000, 1001, 1002, 1006, MATH 1115), 9 Level I elective credits, 30 advanced core credits, and 30 advanced elective credits. Joint Biology/EnvSci majors should read both BIOL 2464 and ESST 3000. Non-joint students read BIOL 2464 instead of ESST 3000. Joint Biology or Math major students should not read BIOL 2163.
